visualCharacteristics: New variant (no existing variants in project): Fund finder panel: name/ISIN input, asset class and legal structure selects, result count button, view-all link | Light blue band (.cmp-fund-finder, #dbedff). Left: white panel with fund search (text input, 2 selects, 'View N results' button, 'View all funds' link). Right: text-only slider with Prev/Next circle arrows (4 slides: MyJupiter, FAQ, Wake up to UK equities, Funds in the spotlight; tab labels hidden). The two blocks sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile.

contentPattern.reason: Interactive search and filter component (input, dropdowns, live result count), which an author cannot type as default content.

cells: Absolute URL to the data/query index to search (fund list endpoint)

usage: Fund search panel: optional intro row (e.g. heading "Search for a fund"), a row with the fund data URL (.json with a data array of name, isin, assetClass, legalStructure, path), and a row with the "View all funds" link. Renders a name/ISIN input, asset class and legal structure selects, and a live "View N results" button that opens the all-funds page with q/assetClass/legalStructure query parameters.
reuseGuidance: Use wherever the fund finder appears. Select options are derived from the data source, falling back to the source-site lists when no data is available.
